title: Gygea wife of Amyntas
summary: Raleigh names Gygea wife of Amyntas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Gygea, the second Wife of Amyntas the second, mother of Archelaus, Argaeus, and a gapped sonne. She is not Gygea, sister of Alexander the sonne of Amintas. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
